audio.title: Audio source & monitoring
audio.sub: Choose one of local mic, phone mic, or computer system audio, and monitor through the computer speakers
audio.computerHint:
Choosing "Computer audio" opens a sharing dialog: in Chrome, sharing "Entire screen" lets you check "Share system audio"; in Edge / Firefox, choose "Tab" and check "Share tab audio" (these two browsers do not support system audio for the entire screen). The sharing window can be minimized but must stay open.
If the browser never offers an audio option: enable "Stereo Mix" under Windows "Sound settings → Recording devices", then select that device as the "Local microphone" to capture system audio.
audio.hint: Browsers only play audio after a user click, so monitoring must be enabled manually. Wear headphones when monitoring the local microphone, otherwise it may cause feedback squealing.
audio.computerHintNative: The desktop client has built-in system audio capture: choosing "Computer audio" directly captures the local speaker output (WASAPI loopback) without a sharing dialog. System audio will no longer be monitored through the speakers, avoiding an echo loop; viewers can still hear it normally.
audio.guideFirefox: Firefox does not support sharing system audio: choose "Tab" in the sharing dialog and check the audio option, or use Chrome instead
audio.guideEdge: Edge does not support sharing system audio for the entire screen: choose "Tab" in the sharing dialog and check "Share tab audio", or use Chrome instead
audio.guideDefault: No computer audio was captured: check "Share system audio" in the sharing dialog, or choose "Tab" and check "Share tab audio"
